claims: Lauren Betts (#51) is a 6-foot-7 center for the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team.
As of April 2026, Lauren Betts has led UCLA to back-to-back Final Four appearances.
Lauren Betts had a 23-point, 10-rebound performance against Duke to reach the 2026 Final Four.
Lauren Betts had a 67-block season at UCLA.
Lauren Betts had a 35-point game in the 2026 NCAA tournament.
Lauren Betts transferred to UCLA after her freshman season at Stanford.
Lauren Betts was named a Big Ten defensive standout in 2025.
